glossary.definition: (1) "Cost-sharing" means the cost to an enrollee under an individual or group health insuring corporation policy, contract, or agreement according to any coverage limit, copayment, coinsurance, deductible, or other out-of-pocket expense requirements imposed by the policy, contract, or agreement.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.68 - Provisions for medication synchronization for enrollees.

glossary.definition: (2) "Drug" has the same meaning as in section 4729.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.68 - Provisions for medication synchronization for enrollees.

glossary.definition: (3) "Medication synchronization" means a pharmacy service that synchronizes the filling or refilling of prescriptions in a manner that allows the dispensed drugs to be obtained on the same date each month.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.68 - Provisions for medication synchronization for enrollees.

glossary.definition: (4) "Prescriber" has the same meaning as in section 4729.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1751.68 - Provisions for medication synchronization for enrollees.
